overview: A once-famous painter rediscovers inspiration when he befriends a sleepwalking cannibal.

recs.blurb: Ten stories, each inspired by one of the ten commandments.
Teenage friends must resist the spell of an evil showman staging a house of horrors show in their small town.
A newly possessed cheerleader turns into a killer who specializes in offing her male classmates. Can her best friend put an end to the horror?
Inspired by the E.C. comics of the 1950s, George A.Romero and Stephen King bring five tales of terror to the screen.
Dr. Jekyll (Mark Blankfield) inhales white powder and becomes an obnoxious Southern Californian.
With their women having been enslaved by a pack of lesbian vampires, the remaining menfolk of a rural town send two hapless young lads out onto the moors as a…
Two brothers, desperate to break into the world of television and film, decide to enter a horror movie contest. And what could be more horrifying than the…
Inspired by his fiancée (who dumped him), a man publishes a break-up handbook for men, becoming a bestselling author in the process.
A teenager teams up with the daughter of young adult horror author R.L. Stine after the writer's imaginary demons are set free on the town of Madison, Delaware.
Inspired by a true story, a comedy centered on a 27-year-old guy who learns of his cancer diagnosis, and his subsequent struggle to beat the disease.
A horror comedy based on the ancient legend about a pagan creature who punishes children on Christmas.
A spoof of all the "found-footage/documentary style" films released in recent years.
